qualityCriteria.basis: Independent visual inspection of this object source/snapshot, frozen target, selected warm soft reference, catalog contract and actual 2D publisher/held-plane consumer.

criteria.success: Two coherent nori-wrapped maki rolls sit convincingly on one small ivory round plate in the high oblique source view. Rounded roll walls/top rims, plausible food-to-plate contacts and a readable continuous ceramic rim give the dish deliberate volume. Useful improvements to proportions, forms, plate construction or edible details are welcome; exact old facets or rice counts are not constraints.

Both rolls retain dark green nori outer walls, warm white rice rings and visibly pale/bright green cucumber centers with darker green peel. Cucumber maki remains recognizable at66px,40px and32px without introducing other food, garnish, chopsticks, labels or scene elements. The small warm ivory plate supports the food rather than becoming its dominant visual mass.

Rice, cucumber, nori and ceramic separate through warm readable midtones, broad soft highlights and rounded shading. Dark nori retains deep green/olive form information rather than broad flat black dead zones; rice does not blow out into a featureless white ring; cucumber highlights describe juicy faces without losing green identity. No directional ground shadow, exterior glow, bloom or preferred world light direction is added.

Rice reads as controlled rounded grain clusters, cucumber chunks have simple convincing cut faces/peel, and nori texture supports cylindrical form without becoming sharp noisy confetti. Ceramic has a coherent shallow well, rim and soft edge reflection. Detail belongs to edible construction and remains subordinate to the recipe at game size.

At66logical pixels wide on the serving surface,40logical pixels within a preference bubble and32pixels in a cell/context thumbnail, two rice-and-green centers and the nori/plate separation remain readable. Show actual declared standalone placement plus matching-art bubble/held representative context evidence; context-only compositions must be labeled if production recaptures are pending. No blocked plate edge, confusing scale jump, halo or lost cucumber identity is hidden by enlarged presentation.

On light, neutral gray and dark backgrounds at intended and enlarged sizes, the plate/food has a clean integrated exterior without detached flecks, rectangular matte, edge halo, accidental low-alpha debris, clipped rim/rice, hard seams or unintended gaps. Preserve soft antialiasing and interior RGBA. A frozen target’s near-zero-alpha fringe is not an instruction to recreate exterior artifacts.
